bootstrap.estimand_weighting: EVENT-WEIGHTED / SESSION-WEIGHTED, NOT equally weighted annual means
procedure: draw 15 calendar-year labels WITH REPLACEMENT from {2011..2025}
concatenate the complete year blocks, duplicating a year's rows if drawn more than once
compute the EVENT-WEIGHTED P1 mean on the replicated event rows
refit the EXACT fixed P2 OLS on the replicated daily rows
retain the P1 mean and beta_EVENT

cash_proxy.unexplained_gap_behaviour: IMPLEMENTATION HOLD. Do not substitute another cash series.

fixed_p2_model.auction_source: TA_EVENT_CALENDAR.csv, tenor_family in {10-Year, 30-Year} nominal coupon auctions
fixed_p2_model.interpretation: CONDITIONAL LINEAR ASSOCIATION, not causal identification. The control is NOT called conservative.
fixed_p2_model.specification: r_excess(d) = a + beta_EVENT*EVENT(d) + weekday dummies + TOM(d) + HOLD(d) + AUCTION(d) + error(d)

gates.P1: lower endpoint of the nominal 95% calendar-year percentile-bootstrap interval for mean r_net > 0
gates.P2: lower endpoint of the nominal 95% calendar-year percentile-bootstrap interval for beta_EVENT > 0
gates.P3: ONLY if P1 and P2 pass. Delete one complete calendar year at a time, refit the identical objects; EVERY P1 point estimate AND every P2 beta_EVENT point estimate must remain STRICTLY > 0. No deletion-specific significance requirement.

historical_provenance_reservation.note: The pre-S0 independent artifact was NEVER PERSISTED and is NOT RECOVERED. The transcript pinned above is a controller-supplied reconstruction with no original hash. Nothing here claims recovery or retrospective certification.

inference_limitation: 15 year blocks imply approximate, assumption-dependent inference.
A large event count does not create additional independent year clusters.
The bootstrap does NOT establish finite-sample calibrated 95% coverage.
The bootstrap does NOT establish cross-regime replication.
The bootstrap does NOT establish future persistence.
LOYO does NOT validate bootstrap coverage.
LOYO does NOT establish stable magnitudes.
